assessment: Paid sightseeing cable car line from Oasis via Tupahue to Cumbre. It is distinct from the already integrated Pío Nono line, which runs from Zoológico via Chile Nativo to Manuel Foster. The official operator sells separate return tickets for each line and a combined offer.

knownRelatedEntity.name: Teleférico Pío Nono
knownRelatedEntity.distinction: Different stations and line ticket, shared operator and ticket portal.

observations.summerHours: Tuesday–Sunday 10:00–19:45; Monday closed. Operator does not publish exact seasonal boundary dates.
observations.priceFactors: Weekday/weekend, age and route. Current checkout amount may differ from starting price.
observations.access: Wheelchair boarding with lift at Oasis; children under twelve accompanied by an adult.
observations.serviceChanges: Weather or maintenance may alter operation.
